subject: Collector lifecycle and temporary email bridge (AP onboarding runbook)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Nguyen <lucy.nguyen@acme-corp.com>, Acme AP <ap@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Collector lifecycle and temporary email bridge (AP onboarding runbook)

Hi Lucy —

Thanks again for the time today. Per the call, here’s a proposed runbook so we can get Acme on the portal with minimal disruption to AP while you complete SFTP setup. Attached: Acme_AP_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx and a sample UBL for your AP team to validate.

Proposal (high level):
- Week 0: Confirm invoice "creator" (who signs / sends). We can rotate the creator to a dedicated billing-sender email (billing@redwood.com) to match your remit rules.
- Week 1: Enable portal tokenization + invite primary AP contact.
- Week 2: Start SFTP push (if accepted).
- Transition window: For 4 weeks after SFTP starts, we will send copies to your AP inbox as a temporary email bridge.

Questions / asks for you:
1) Is Acme okay with a dedicated billing sender address as the canonical invoice origin?
2) Can AP accept UBL (attached) via SFTP, or do you need PDF email copies for PO matching?
3) Please confirm the AP contact and any PO mapping logic (field names / prefixes).

If you confirm sender and SFTP acceptance, we’ll create the invite and schedule the canary rotation (one business unit first).

Best,
Karthik
Director, GTM Ops — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: Acme_AP_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample_invoice-UBL.xml (xml)

From: Lucy Nguyen <lucy.nguyen@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme AP <ap@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collector lifecycle and temporary email bridge (AP onboarding runbook)

Hi Karthik —

Thanks, this looks good. Quick answers below: 

- Acme is fine with a dedicated billing sender address; please use billing-invoices@redwood.com as the canonical origin.
- We can accept UBL via SFTP but our SFTP will be ready in ~10 business days.
- For the temporary bridge, please CC ap@acme-corp.com on PDFs while SFTP is being finalized — we need the PDF for our matching engine in parallel.

AP contact for invites and testing: Lucia Perez (lucia.perez@acme-corp.com; +1 212-555-0102). She will own sample file validation and PO mapping.

I’ve attached the signed engagement so procurement has the paperwork (signed-engagement.pdf).

Appreciate the clear plan — please confirm timeline and whether we need a DocuSign acceptance before starting invites.

Thanks,
Lucy Nguyen
Finance Operations Manager — Acme Corporation

Attachments: signed-engagement.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lucy Nguyen <lucy.nguyen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collector lifecycle and temporary email bridge (AP onboarding runbook)

Quick note on compliance / consent:

- If Acme prefers the portal as primary, we’ll need ap@acme-corp.com to accept the portal invite (token-based). That acceptance is sufficient; no additional DocuSign is required for onboarding.
- For the temporary PDF bridge, we recommend a 4-week overlap and a short consent line in the invite body that authorizes email copies during the transition (helps our audit log).
- If any invoices contain EU VAT reverse-charge fields, flag those in the sample UBL so our parser tags them for VAT reconciliation.

I’ll prepare the invite language and the consent blurb — will post the draft link to drive after Ben’s canary schedule is set.

—Kimberly
Head of Billing Enablement — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lucy Nguyen <lucy.nguyen@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collector lifecycle and temporary email bridge (AP onboarding runbook)

Team —

We can run a canary rotation for the billing-sender change next Tuesday (Mar 23) for one BU. Steps:
1) Configure billing-invoices@redwood.com as sender for BU-123.
2) Push sample UBL to Acme SFTP (test folder) and send PDF copy to ap@acme-corp.com.
3) Wait 48 hours for CHK/ACK from Acme; if OK, roll to additional BUs.

Links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeOnboarding (sample files + invite copy)
- HubSpot record: HubSpot:RWI-2467

Kimberly — I used the consent blurb you suggested in the invite draft and saved it in the Drive. Karthik — I’ll schedule the invite and include lucia.perez@acme-corp.com as the primary.

Ben
Billing Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Lucy Nguyen <lucy.nguyen@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collector lifecycle and temporary email bridge (AP onboarding runbook)

Thanks Ben — that schedule works for us. Lucia will be on the test folder and will confirm within 48 hours.

Small notes from AP: please ensure the PDF subject line includes our PO number prefix (PO:) so our mail parser picks it up automatically. Also confirm the SFTP credentials will be exchanged via our secure secret channel (we’ll not accept creds over email).

I confirm acceptance of the temporary email copies during the 4-week overlap. Please proceed with the canary on Mar 23.

Lucy
